test: a copy pasted elsewhere, then the original edited > a block that moved while another block changed, with no copy anywhere, is still followed
evidence: A guard written with the fix, not a gap: the old session followed a block by its text, so with no copy it already found a moved block. The test holds that the new line-based following (block-follow.ts) still falls back to the text when a change runs through the whole block and no copy could be it, so stopping for copies never stops a session that only moved.
